scope: Public program/build-manifest bytes for 149 IDs in the extended 187-ID inventory; 20 support sources and 42 verified public compile inputs. The 2026-10-06 extension adds public benchmark/test identities and their literal local Python import closure in place, without copying scientific sources or executing them. origin_path_base: local research archive, paths relative to its root
reconstruction: Copy each canonical file to archive_relative in a fresh destination tree after verifying sha256. Canonical source files may be shared; their on-disk location here is not necessarily their original compilation layout.
excluded: No keys, ciphertexts, full secret phases, biometric payloads, raw runtime logs, cached binaries, target/vendor/build trees or symlinks imported.
